insights.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue jumped 172% to ₹820 Cr with operating EBITDA of ₹120.5 Cr (14.7%) and PAT of ₹85 Cr; AI systems were 62% of revenue. The order book is ₹2,507 Cr plus ₹848 Cr of L1 positions, and the pipeline (now including strategic AI deals) is ₹10,410 Cr, expected to convert about 60% over 18-24 months. Management kept the 13-14% margin range; inventory rose to 110 days and the company moved to net debt of ₹200 Cr, with an enabling resolution to raise capital for working capital.
